records.name: Banchhanidhi Pani, IAS
records.notes: Took over Feb 2025, replacing M. Thennarasan. Could not get a clean direct fetch of ahmedabadcity.gov.in's own commissioner page (404/connection-reset every attempt this session). Indirectly corroborated as still in post on 2026-06-30: AUDA's own contact page (live-fetched this session, see AUDA Chairman record below) still lists Pani as AUDA Chairman, and in Gujarat that chairmanship runs with the sitting AMC Commissioner post. Distinct fact, not to be conflated: a separate Section 7A 'Administrator' (Mukesh Kumar, IAS) was appointed 10 March 2026 to run the AMC's ELECTED wing (General Board/Mayor/Standing Committee) after the prior council's term lapsed on 9 March 2026 (source: https://deshgujarat.com/2026/03/07/ias-mukesh-kumar-appointed-amc-administrator-as-elected-bodys-term-ends/) -- but this repo's governance.json already records an elected AMC council in place since April 2026 (BJP, 160/192), so that Administrator interregnum appears to have ended and is not the current arrangement; it is unrelated to, and does not replace, the permanent executive Commissioner post.

Page itself returned 404 on direct WebFetch this session; phone/email corroborated via search-result snippet of this exact URL, not a clean live fetch. No personal phone/email for the Commissioner's office is publicly listed anywhere found.
